thread:
Maya: dropping the revised account settings form here. two big q's: do we mark required fields with an asterisk + SR text or show explicit "(required)" inline? and for unlinking third-party integrations should we use a lightweight modal or require typing the integration name?
Noah: for forms i prefer asterisk visually and SR-only explicit text. keeps visual noise down.
Priya: asterisk alone is risky. SR-only "required" works but ensure label includes aria-required or add an offscreen span.
Jon: agree. also consider flipping to mark only optional fields when most fields are required — reduces markers. but that pattern surprises some people. maybe only for very dense forms.
Maya: good point. maybe a rule: if >75% required then mark optional, else mark required. we can surface this as a guideline in design tokens.
Priya: on errors: inline messages are best for immediate fix. but on long/mobile forms show a compact banner summarizing errors with a count and link to the first error. prevents users from hunting.
Noah: error tone: use verbs and examples: "Enter a valid phone (e.g., +1 555-555-5555)" instead of "Phone invalid". action-first helps scanning.
Jon: for destructive actions, introduce tiers: 
- low-risk unlink: confirmation modal with clear copy and checkbox to remove data (optional)
- high-risk (delete org/integration): typed-confirm that requires exact name.
Priya: typed-confirm should be reserved. it's a stopgap that can cause support friction if microcopy is unclear. provide a copy pattern: "Type the name to confirm deletion: "Acme Connector"" and show an inline validation state as they type.
Maya: accessibility notes: when error occurs move focus to the first invalid control, announce summary via role="status" or "alert"; color alone shouldn't convey state; provide icons + text.
aria-bot: a11y checklist: focus on first error, aria-describedby for messages, aria-required on required inputs, ensure contrast ratios, keyboard operable modals, typed-confirm accessible to SR users.
Noah: implementation detail: add data-attribute flags for required/optional to help QA and analytics. we can track how often users hit typed-confirm to justify UX cost.
Priya: also add a small helper: "Press ? for keyboard shortcuts" in modals; ensure Enter triggers primary but not by accident for typed-confirm.
Maya: i'll update the mocks with: SR-only "(required)" copy, inline verb-first error messages, mobile summary banner, and a tiered confirmation pattern. will post updated PNG later today.
Jon: perfect. aim to lock copy before Friday sync so engineering can estimate. :thumbsup:
